critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck primitive along the longitudinal axis of the fuselage. Increase its length by 40% to move the rear terminus significantly further back from the cockpit area, ensuring it aligns with the reference's elongated profile. Simultaneously, increase the width of this same primitive by 25% and raise its vertical height by 15% to create a more substantial horizontal footprint that integrates smoothly into the main fuselage body.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and rounded, blending quickly into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, elevated section with a more pronounced vertical rise from the nose.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase height of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears narrow and vertically oriented.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wider horizontal footprint across the forward fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, abrupt junction between the cockpit area and the main body.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve where the upper deck integrates into the primary fuselage structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: adjust curvature/radius of the hump-to-fuselage joint
